text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes:

- **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025. Drivers checking in at Dock Doors 14–18 in the Eau Claire yard weren't getting their SMS bay assignments. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed on 5 Oct that the fix worked. The same note asks for the kiosk logs to be archived before the 14 Oct 2025 maintenance window.
- **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Thea also opened this one. The gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. It was passed up to tier-2 support for firmware testing. The note doesn't say whether it was fixed.

What I left out:
- **#4409 and #4412** are in Moss's Central handoffs note, but they belong to Marrow Fieldworks, not QFL.
- **Marcus's note on "Quarendon Freightways"** (one "r") is about a different company that isn't our customer. It isn't a Moss note and has no tickets.

I checked all six Moss notes you have access to. His other North notes from 14 Sep 2025 and 23 Mar 2026 mention QFL but give no ticket numbers.
